Need to search first.I couldn't write any notes on Psalm 6 this time, because my research tools stopped working before I could read a single page.

- **First attempt:** I tried to open seven sources at once (Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Augustine on New Advent, Bible Hub commentaries, Gill on StudyLight, and the NET Bible notes). That hit the search tool's usage limit, and every request failed.
- **Second attempt:** I tried to open one page directly. It was refused because the tool only opens links that have first come up in a search.
- **Third attempt:** When I tried to search first, I had no tool calls left.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes, tradition comparisons or other views. Anything I wrote now would come from memory, not from cited pages.

**Next step:** Ask me again in a new message. I'll search first and then open the pages one at a time, starting with these:
1. enduringword.com on Psalm 6
2. biblehub.com commentaries on Psalm 6 (Ellicott, Pulpit, Gill, and others), verse by verse
3. studylight.org (Gill) and preceptaustin.org
4. netbible.org notes, especially on "Sheminith" (v. 1) and "Sheol" (v. 5)
5. newadvent.org (Augustine on Psalm 6) and Catholic sources on it as a penitential psalm
6. Teachers from each tradition on vv. 1 and 5: Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*, Wesley's notes, Lutheran sources, and Reformed sources
